Job Description

ServiceNow empowers organizations with AI-driven autonomous workflows to streamline operations and achieve results. We seek an experienced solution sales specialist with business expertise and technical skills to drive growth for our Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.

This quota carrying sales role will partner with enterprise sales teams to identify opportunities, lead strategic discovery, demonstrate solutions, and close complex deals. Your dual expertise—part consultant, part seller—positions you to bridge technical capability and business value in ways that resonate with executive stakeholders.

Build and refine the qualification criteria, account strategy, sales motion, and the pitch.
Build pipeline and generate revenue for Autonomous Finance, Procurement, and Legal Workflow solutions.
Lead executive discovery sessions to uncover challenges and quantify AI value.
Develop account strategies focused on customer transformation.
Deliver impactful demonstrations and handle technical questions.
Establish trusted relationships with executive sponsors and collaborate across teams.
Stay informed about emerging AI technologies and workflow automation trends.
What Makes You Successful
Balance executive presence with technical know-how.
Simplify technology into clear business narratives.
Thrive in ambiguous situations and solve complex problems.
Prioritize high-impact opportunities.
Work well in matrixed environments.

7+ years of enterprise software sales or consulting experience.
Proven success selling complex SaaS, ERP, finance, legal, or AI solutions.
Domain expertise in procurement, financial operations, contract management, or legal tech.
Experience in overlay, matrixed, or specialized sales.
Skilled at leading executive engagements and product demonstrations.
Strong executive communication and organizational skills.
Willingness to travel

Experience selling or working with AI platforms and intelligent automation.
Familiarity with ServiceNow, SAP, Oracle, Workday, Ariba, Coupa, etc.
Knowledge of APIs, integrations, and enterprise architecture.
Active use of AI tools.
MBA or equivalent work experience.

Armis from ServiceNow is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Business Development Representative (BDR) to join our growing sales team. This role is crucial in driving top-of-funnel growth by identifying and qualifying high-potential leads for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will possess a proven track record of success in BDR roles, particularly within the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry. They will be a self-starter with excellent communication and organisational skills, and a strong understanding of the sales process.

Proactively identify and generate new business opportunities through targeted outbound prospecting, including cold calling, emailing, social selling, and leveraging relevant industry events.
Qualify and convert inbound leads generated from marketing campaigns, events and website inquiries.
Conduct thorough research to understand prospect needs, pain points, and business objectives.
Utilise CRM (Salesforce) to accurately track and manage all activities and interactions.

Schedule discovery calls for qualified sales opportunities for Account Executives.

Territory buildout responsibilities in partnership with your Account Executives (account mapping, research, persona mapping)

Stay up-to-date on industry trends, competitive landscape, and emerging technologies in the cybersecurity space.
Develop a strong understanding of target industries and customer personas.
Provide feedback to marketing and product marketing teams based on prospect interactions and market insights.

Consistently meet or exceed monthly and quarterly targets for qualified opportunities and meetings.
Provide regular reports on activity, pipeline, and performance metrics.
Participate in ongoing training and development to enhance sales skills and product knowledge.

Minimum of 1-2 years of experience in a BDR or sales development role, preferably in the cybersecurity or enterprise software industry.
Proven track record of consistently exceeding sales targets.
Experience with CRM systems (Salesforce preferred) and sales enablement tools.
Experience working collaboratively across business functions (Channel, Sales, Marketing).

Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
Strong prospecting, qualification, and creative problem solving skills.
Ability to build rapport and establish relationships with potential customers.
Strong organisational and time management skills.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
Confidence in articulating a multi-product suite (platform sale).

Demonstrated ability to understand customer pain points and translate them into specific solutions with measurable business outcomes.
Strong follow-up skills to ensure customer satisfaction and continued success post-sale.

Hungry & Hardworking, self-motivated, results-driven, and goal-oriented with a strong desire to succeed.
Open to coaching, feedback, and continuous sales skills and technical knowledge improvement.

Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline through outbound prospecting and strategic account development
Expand relationships within accounts by aligning AI solutions to broader engineering and manufacturing initiatives
Achieve or exceed assigned revenue targets and sales objectives
Consultative Selling & Solution Alignment
Lead discovery conversations to uncover customer challenges and identify practical AI applications (e.g., process efficiency, workflow automation, data visibility)

Meet or exceed monthly and quarterly activity metrics and sales quotas set by management.
Effectively overcome objections, communicate value propositions, and close deals.
Present and communicate sales offerings to customers and team members using tools like NetSuite, MS Office, and other electronic methods.

If you've done outbound for a while, you know what most SDR roles actually look like: a number on a board, a script to follow, and meetings that get booked whether they're ready or not. We built this role differently.
Our SDRs spend 15 to 30 minutes on a qualifying call. Not to pitch, but to actually understand what's broken in a prospect's business and whether it's worth an AE's time. We call it a pain chain: symptom, root cause, business cost. And: No chain, no meeting; the AE will send it back for further qualification. It keeps the quality honest and it means the work you do actually matters downstream. If you're ready to trade volume for something with more substance, it's worth a conversation.
🎯 What you’ll own
Your accounts are mid-market and enterprise (150-5,000 employees). You run the full qualification process before anything reaches an AE, which in practice looks like this:
Qualification calls that go long enough to build a real case, not just confirm that someone picked up
Re-engagement on accounts that have been approached before, with a genuine plan for how to get in differently
Follow-up calls with yourself when a first conversation doesn't go deep enough, rather than booking something that isn't ready
Finding your own contacts when the data isn't clean, because it often isn't
Keeping HubSpot honest so your pipeline reflects reality
Working closely enough with your AE that what you hand off actually lands

You've done B2B outbound before and you have a real opinion on what makes a qualification call worth something. That's the baseline.
1-2 years of outbound sales or SDR experience in B2B
You've worked accounts with no clean data, navigated gatekeepers, and made multi-touch sequences actually work
You think about pipeline quality, not just volume, and you can explain the difference to someone who disagrees
Fluent German, working English
You manage your own day well and take feedback seriously when it comes
🤩 What's different here
The qualification bar here is genuinely high. A meeting without a clear pain chain doesn't move forward, and you're expected to know that before it reaches the AE. There's no hiding behind dial counts or activity metrics when the pipeline tells a different story.
The accounts you'll work aren't easy. No clean contact data, gatekeepers who've heard every opener, prospects who need a few different approaches before they pick up. The job isn't to call more. It's to find the angle that works, and to keep looking until you do.
When it clicks, you feel it. Your pipeline moves, your meetings convert, and the AE comes back wanting more. People here have moved to AE in around 24 months. That track is real, and it starts with the quality of what you build in this role.

About Atira
Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.
We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!
Why this role compounds
Sales is the one skill that compounds across every career path. Whether you become a founder, a closer, or a senior commercial leader, the people who got there learned the craft early. Atira is where you learn it right.
You will be one of the first persons we hire in our GTM team. This means you will define how Atira finds, qualifies, and engages customers across our key verticals. This role goes well beyond what you would do at any other early stage startup looking for BDRs right now. We are looking for someone who is up for a real challenge in a fast moving environment and in return can become an Account Executive at Atira within the next 8-12 months.

s.h: How the role sits in the team
s.t: As Atira scales, we build industry-specific "pods" at the heart of our GTM approach: Forward Deployed Engineer, Account Executive, BDR, Product Marketer, and a GTM Engineer. The BDR sits at the front of the pod, working hand-in-hand with the GTM Engineer and AE to bring success stories from existing customers to new ones. The story flywheel starts with you.

We have some of the highest profile enterprise customers and are building the story around them. In parallel our team is growing fast to meet the inbound demand we are currently getting across customer segments and sizes.
We are now heavily scaling our GTM Team and are looking for founding team members to re-define how industrials sell complex products.

Building the outbound engine. You design the sequences, test the channels (phone, email, LinkedIn, events), and figure out what works even better at industrial customers. The global playbook starts now, you help write it
Work closely with our Forward Deployed Engineering Teams. You will be the story teller of our deep and impactful Enterprise engagements. No mass blasts. We are working with the industry leaders in each sub vertical. You will know more about a customer's sales & engineering process than most of their own sales engineers before the first meeting.
Customer outreach. You will speak with industrial leaders & Sales Engineers across different industrial verticals and be a key person within the initial sales process together with founders and Account executives.
Become AI-native in your craft. You proactively identify where AI accelerates outbound work, you experiment with new approaches, and you share what works with the rest of the team
Feed learnings back into product and marketing. What objection comes up in 70% of cold calls? Which ICP segment responds best to which message? You are the ground truth on what the market actually says, and that signal flows back to our founders, the AE, and the product team

Hunger, structure, and the kind of resilience that does not wilt after seven dial-tones in a row. Problem-solving, creativity, and drive matter more than the right number of years on your CV. We have hired strong people from non-traditional backgrounds before. We will confidently do it again.
That said, the following references give a guideline of what we typically see in strong candidates.
Your profile
You are motivated to build something from the ground up. You take ownership of work others would delegate and finish what you start
Fluent in German and English
Ideally, concrete evidence of hitting outbound targets in a prior role. If you don't have prior experience, you compensate with a serious side hustle, sales-heavy student initiative, or another track record of convincing people to do hard things
AI-native outbound: you have built your own research and personalisation stack and know how to scale personalisation without it becoming spam
Genuine curiosity about manufacturing and industrials. You don't need to know what a defense or aerospace RFQ involves on day one, but you need to be the kind of person who will know in week three. Ideally, you have already looked it up by reading this
What you'll get
Real ownership. You'll be one of the first BDRs and contribute to the playbook from day one. What works for the next five hires will be what you figured out
Close collaboration with our co-founder Florian (ex-Palantir DACH commercial lead). You iterate the playbook with him, benefitting from his experience
Validated traction. Leading Industrial customers including several with revenues above €1B within a clearly defined ICP. You are not hunting in the dark
Clear AE pathway. Strong BDRs move into an AE seat within 12-18 months. For this strategic hire we have a fast track
AI-native sales stack. Attio, Apollo, plus whatever else helps you close. We get you the tools you need
Competitive base equity package, uncapped variable. OTE designed so over-performance is real money, not symbolic
Central Munich office. Vibrant in-office culture additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and dinners
Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity
What success looks like after a few months
You have co-built the first version of the outbound playbook: named sequences per ICP segment, tested openers, working objection handlers
You have multi-threaded into multiple named accounts on your own, with key stakeholders engaged at each
You drive our pipeline beyond the current hype we already experience
AE and FDE trust your handoffs without re-qualifying

Über Statista
Bei Statista dreht sich alles um Daten und Fakten, denn wir sind die weltweit führende Business Data Plattform. 2007 in Hamburg gegründet, haben wir uns schnell zu einem globalen Unternehmen mit Büros in Metropolen wie London, New York und Tokio entwickelt. Und wir haben auch weiterhin viel vor. Unser stetiges Wachstum ist nicht nur Beweis für unseren Erfolg, sondern schafft auch immer neue Entwicklungs- und Karrieremöglichkeiten für unsere Mitarbeiter:innen.
Wir schätzen und feiern unsere vielfältige Kultur. Hier bist Du willkommen, egal, wer Du bist, woher Du kommst, wie Du aussiehst oder welche Graphen und Diagramme Du bevorzugst. Why Harvey
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished.

We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.

As a Sales Development Representative at Harvey, you will be at the forefront of driving the growth and adoption of our AI solutions across the legal and professional services markets. You will own early-stage pipeline creation across EMEA by engaging law firms, professional services organizations, and in-house legal teams, understanding their unique challenges, and introducing Harvey’s AI platform.
This role combines highly personalized outbound prospecting with thoughtful inbound qualification. Your ability to articulate the value of Harvey's products, paired with curiosity about AI and a rigorous approach to your work, will help us expand our reach and shape the future of knowledge work.

Build revenue pipeline aligned with Harvey’s strategic customer profile using a variety of outbound tools and highly personalized outreach.
Proactively prospect into target accounts across EMEA through email, phone, LinkedIn, and other creative outbound strategies.
Source and qualify new sales opportunities through both outbound prospecting and inbound lead follow-up.
Conduct thoughtful discovery conversations to understand customer workflows and determine strong opportunities for the sales team.
Respond quickly to inbound interest and ensure timely qualification and follow-up.
Partner closely with Account Executives to develop opportunities and support early-stage deal progression.
Provide data-driven insights to inform sales strategies and improve prospecting effectiveness.
Contribute to developing Harvey’s sales playbook and document learnings as we scale the team globally.
Consistently achieve and exceed qualified pipeline and activity targets.
What You Have
1–2+ years of experience in a fast-growing startup, preferably in sales development or project management.
Fluent in written and spoken English and Arabic.
Strong executive presence and comfort presenting to sophisticated executive buyers.
Independent, driven, and approach work with rigor and thoughtfulness.
Ability to convey technical concepts to non-technical audiences.
Proficient with Salesforce, Salesloft, and reporting tools.
Collaborative team player able to work across internal functions.
Passionate about Harvey’s mission with a strong understanding of AI applications in knowledge work.
Interest in the legal profession; experience in the legal industry is a plus but not required.

Who We Are
Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together . We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Notion is rebuilding its go-to-market motion around a workflow-first, builder-led model—and the BDR is at the front of it. As a Business Development Rep, you'll be the force that turns the right accounts into the right conversations.

You'll partner closely with Solutions Consultants to identify and target companies that are ready to rethink how they work—and your job is to get them in the room. This isn't generic pipeline work: you're qualifying for workflow-first, build-ready opportunities that set SCs up to win.

If you're competitive, curious, and energised by outbound that actually means something, this is the role for you.
What You'll Achieve
Generate qualified, workflow-first pipeline by identifying and targeting high-potential accounts in your assigned book, partnering with your sellers on account and outbound strategy
Run multi-channel outbound campaigns—email, phone, LinkedIn, and events—to create urgency and secure first meetings with the right decision-makers
Conduct initial qualification to ensure meetings handed to sellers are "ready to build," not just "ready to talk"—validating ICP, intent, and workflow fit before the handoff
Document and deliver clean handoff packets in Salesforce with ICP signals, pain points, workflow hypothesis, and stakeholder context so sellers can hit the ground running
Leverage GTM System tooling and intent data to sharpen targeting, prioritize accounts by signal strength, and increase the quality and consistency of your outbound motion
Skills You'll Need to Bring
Business fluency in English
Proven track record in outbound pipeline generation, with hands-on experience in cold prospecting across phone, email, and social channels
Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to craft compelling, persona-specific outreach that earns a response
Sharp qualification instincts—able to quickly assess ICP fit, identify urgency, and set solutions consultants up for high-quality first conversations
Passion for AI/ML and understanding of API-first or consumption-based business models
High-activity mindset with the discipline to prioritise based on signal and data, not just volume
You don't need to be an AI expert, but you're curious and willing to adopt AI tools to work smarter and deliver better results.

Experience with Salesforce, Outreach, or similar GTM tooling
Familiarity with Notion as a product or prior experience selling productivity, collaboration, or workflow software
Background in a high-velocity, metric-driven outbound environment with clear pipeline targets

About Ramp
Ramp is building the smart infrastructure for finance teams, embedded in the transaction flow of every dollar a business spends. We automate how over $200B in annualized spend flows in and out of 70,000+ companies: authorizing payments, flagging risk, categorizing spend, and closing books.
The problems are high-stakes, data-dense, and unforgiving.
We hire people with high agency and high urgency. We look for slope over intercept. We care less about where you trained and more about what you’ve built. At Ramp, everyone is a builder who owns problems end to end and makes consequential decisions that shape the outcome.
The median Ramp customer saves 5% and grows revenue 16% in their first year – far in excess of businesses operating without Ramp. We believe every ambitious company deserves the same.
If you want to build systems that directly shape how companies move and manage billions, Ramp is the place to do it.

As a Business Development Representative in our Toronto office, you will be focused on building Ramp’s presence in the Canadian market. In this high-velocity, high-impact outbound role, you will create qualified opportunities for Ramp’s Account Executives and bring in high-quality pipeline.
Our sales organization is looking for someone who is hungry, highly coachable, self-motivated and has a natural inclination for selling – a builder who can perform in ambiguity. As part of our early-stage team, you’ll act as the initial point of contact in prospecting and qualifying leads. If you’re eager to make an impact, embrace challenges and are passionate about playing a key role in defining Ramp’s presence in Canada and accelerating growth in this new market, this role is for you.

Source new business across Canada through outbound prospecting and outreach
Identify the right finance, operations, and executive stakeholders within target accounts.
Execute thoughtful, personalized multi-channel outbound campaigns
Run confident cold calls and consultative discovery
Clearly articulate and tailor Ramp’s value to prospective customers
Handle objections with curiosity, composure, and persistence.
Maintain accurate activity, account, contact, and opportunity data in Salesforce.
Collaborate cross-functionally on feedback, competitive insights, local-market learnings
What you need
AI fluency as a daily habit . Ramp is a builder culture: if you don't instinctively reach for AI before doing things manually, this role will be a hard adjustment.
Grit, ownership, and resourcefulness
Strong written and verbal communication
Strong research, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail
Dedication to consistent self-improvement
Self-starter with a high sense of urgency
Comfortable operating in a fast-paced environment
Ability to work 3x a week in Ramp’s Toronto office

Professional proficiency or native-level fluency in French
Experience exceeding quota in a B2B SDR/BDR or other outbound sales role.
Experience selling B2B software, financial services, fintech, or to finance/exec teams.
Experience with Salesforce, Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo, Outreach.
Familiarity with the Canadian business or fintech landscape.

A atuação será predominantemente em Outbound , com eventual suporte ao atendimento de leads oriundos de ações de Inbound .
Principais responsabilidades
Realizar prospecção ativa de empresas por segmento de mercado, utilizando listas, ferramentas de inteligência comercial e CRM.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.
So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff.

Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place.

Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.
Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

We’re building a team of elite sales leaders who raise the performance of everyone around them.
As a Sales Manager, you'll lead a team of approximately 8 Account Executives while owning one of our most important growth levers: developing talent that consistently outperforms expectations. This role isn't about managing activity, it's about building a high-performance sales organization where every hire strengthens the team, every coaching conversation improves execution, and every business decision is grounded in data.
You'll be expected to coach in the work, not after it. You'll diagnose pipeline health before it becomes a forecasting problem, develop future leaders before promotions become necessary, and create an operating rhythm that enables predictable, repeatable growth.
You'll partner cross-functionally to improve how we sell, challenge the status quo, and continuously raise the talent bar across the organization. Success is measured not only by quota attainment, but by the strength of your team, the quality of your pipeline, and the leaders you develop.
You Will
Build a High-Performance Team
Hire exceptional Account Executives and raise the talent bar with every addition to your team.
Develop a culture of ownership, accountability, continuous learning and high standards.
Identify future top performers early and create development plans that accelerate their growth.
Coach Through Data & Business Intelligence
Lead your business through rigorous pipeline inspection, forecasting and performance diagnostics.
Use leading indicators to identify performance gaps early and coach reps toward sustainable improvement.
Turn data into action by identifying trends, diagnosing root causes and driving measurable improvements across your team.
Driver Operational Excellence
Establish predictable operating rhythms around forecasting, pipeline management and business reviews.
Build disciplined education that creates consistent, repeatable revenue outcomes.
Continuously improve how your team sells by refining processes, simplifying execution and eliminating friction.
Lead Through Influence
Partner closing with sales Leadership, Marketing, Enablement, Operations and Product to improve the customer journey and strengthen commercial execution.
Use customer insights and field intelligence to shape strategy and influence product evolution.
Lead through change by helping your team adapt quickly while maintaining high performance.
You Have
4+ years experience as a sales manager.
3 years of documented sales success as an individual contributor exceeding target.
A proven track record leading high-performing sales teams in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.
Success developing Account Executives into top performers through structured coaching and clear performance expectations.
Deep expertise in pipeline management, forecasting, and using data to improve business outcomes.
Demonstrated experience hiring exceptional talent and building teams that consistently outperform.
Strong business judgment with the ability to balance short-term execution and long-term organizational health.

Welcome to On! We are one of the World’s fastest-growing premium sportswear brands and we’re redefining the future of sportswear.
On is disrupting the global sports footwear, apparel, and accessories market with groundbreaking technology, cutting-edge designs, and an unwavering commitment to sustainability and social impact. We're not just thinking differently – we're pushing the boundaries of what’s possible, inspiring athletes and customers alike.
We’re excited to offer a unique opportunity for a passionate and Culturally attuned Sales Representative to join our growing Nordic sales team, with a specific focus on sneaker, streetwear and fashion accounts, including the most influential sneaker destinations, premium concept stores and boutiques.

Expanding our presence in the sneaker segment
Consolidating our position within the fashion/concept boutiques

Imagine working in a team where a passion for people and a commitment to movement come first. At On, you’ll join a community of athletes, sports lovers, and innovation-driven individuals who aren’t afraid to think differently and move fast.
As Strategic Key Account Manager Italy, you will act as the commercial leader for a portfolio of strategically important accounts, working cross-functionally with Sales, Marketing, Merchandising, Product, Retail Marketing, Demand Planning and Finance teams.
You will be a key voice within the Italian organization, helping shape distribution strategy, identify growth opportunities and ensure that On remains one of the most desirable brands within both the performance and lifestyle channels.

Develop and strengthen strategic relationships with some of the most influential Nordic accounts, including sneaker stores, concept stores, and fashion-forward independents.
Discover and onboard new accounts aligned with On’s Performance All Day vision and global brand direction.
Guide sell-in and support sell-out with a clear focus on product storytelling, brand elevation, and curated assortments.
Leverage data and market insight to guide assortment and account planning.
Analyze market trends, consumer behavior, and competitor activity to inform strategies and identify growth opportunities.
Maintain sales-related budgets and support forecasting and demand planning processe

Experience: Typically 3–5 years of experience in sales, account management, or brand roles within the sportswear, fashion, lifestyle, or premium industry. We welcome candidates from international and dynamic environments (e.g., premium consumer goods, retail/wholesale, international brand roles).
Cultural Connection: Passionate about style, culture, and community — with an authentic connection to the sneaker/streetwear world.
Energy & Adaptability: Demonstrated strong commitment and motivation to work for the On brand, combined with the ability to grow and adapt in highly dynamic and cross-functional environments.
Mobility: A valid driver’s license and the ability to drive are essential to fulfill job responsibilities.
Language: Fluency or C1+ level in English (written and spoken) is required, as English is On’s shared professional language. Knowledge of a Nordic language is a plus.

None of this work is possible without the incredible people behind it. We're a mission-based company that invests in an inclusive culture, so we can innovate together and ensure everyone has the space to grow, thrive, and belong.
And starting right now, we want to do all that with you.

Available to work a minimum of 3 days per week, weekends included

Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy.
After years of building an innovative POS platform for restaurateurs, Toast is expanding its offerings into other food and beverage concepts such as convenience stores, grocery stores, and bottle shops. As a Retail Business Development Representative (BDR), you will be part of a founding team that is transforming the way Retailers operate. You will serve as the critical first step in our sales pipeline, responsible for building and qualifying the opportunities that drive our growth.

Generate lists of prospective convenience stores, grocery stores, bottle shops, and other retailers to target.
Execute high-volume outreach to a mix of prospective businesses to determine mutual fit.
Complete 80 activities daily (cold calls).
Conduct qualification calls to develop an understanding of the prospect’s needs and determine how they can benefit from leveraging our Retail solution.

When it comes to digital communities, The Alliance is leading the way. Product marketing, sales enablement, product-led growth, AI, customer success, CMOs, you name it, we’re home to thriving communities for them all.
With 70,000+ professionals across our communities and a constant stream of events, memberships, and learning products, we help individuals and teams grow faster in their careers. We work with some of the world’s most recognisable companies and pride ourselves on being a high-impact learning partner, not just another events business.
We’re ambitious, we move quickly, and we’re still early in the journey. That means real ownership, a steep learning curve, and plenty of opportunity to shape what comes next.

We’re hiring early-career Sales Associates to join our Delegate & Membership sales team , people with energy, curiosity, and the drive to build a career in commercial roles.
This is a junior role by design. You don’t need years of experience, what matters most is how quickly you learn, how well you take feedback, and how comfortable you are being challenged. We’ll teach you how to sell properly: how to prospect, qualify, handle objections, manage a pipeline, and close, all while speaking to senior decision-makers at some of the world’s biggest tech companies.
You’ll sell across our live events, memberships, and learning solutions in markets including London, New York, San Francisco, Las Vegas and beyond. Over time, this role can progress into more senior sales or specialist commercial paths across the business.
This role is not about arriving fully formed, it’s about building and proving confidence, capability, and momentum through doing.
What You'll Be Doing
Sales Upskilling: You’ll build strong foundations in prospecting, qualification, pipeline management, and closing, while learning how to sell confidently to senior B2B stakeholders and work to clear targets and expectations.
Engaging decision-makers: You’ll speak directly with professionals at fast-growing and enterprise tech companies, understand their challenges, and recommend the right events, memberships, and learning solutions.
Owning deals end-to-end: You’ll own your pipeline from first contact through to close and handover, taking accountability for outcomes and using feedback and data to improve week by week.
Product mastery: You’ll develop strong knowledge of our events, memberships, and education ecosystem, enabling confident and relevant cross-selling.
Collaboration & feedbac k: You’ll work closely with marketing, product, community, and customer success teams, sharing insights and operating with autonomy while knowing when to ask for support.
This Role Is For You If
You’re early in your career and hungry to learn, not entitled to results
You’re comfortable being uncomfortable while learning something new
You actively seek feedback and apply it quickly
You take ownership for outcomes, not just effort
You’re resilient, organised, and able to manage pace and pressure
You communicate clearly with customers and with teammates
You enjoy working as part of a team where success is shared
Our Hiring Process
Our hiring process is designed to reflect how we actually work: collaborative, practical, and focused on potential rather than polish.
First interview (values, motivation, and learning mindset)
One-day assessment in our London office (practical exercises, collaboration, and real-world sales scenarios)
Final shortlist: up to 3 candidates selected into an onboarding cohort, starting together and learning side-by-side
This process helps us understand how you think, learn, and show up — not just how well you interview.

Our Human Health Division maintains a “patient first, profits later” ideology. The organization is comprised of sales, marketing, market access, digital analytics and commercial professionals who are passionate about their role in bringing our medicines to our customers worldwide.
We are looking for an experienced and results-driven Account Manager to manage our existing Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) business and lead the launch of an exciting new product across the Swiss German part of Switzerland.

This role requires strong expertise in pharmaceutical sales, strategic planning and relationship-building with key healthcare professionals. The Account Manager will also work closely with marketing to create and implement impactful materials, projects and campaigns.

While experience in Pulmonary Hypertension and rare diseases is a plus, we welcome candidates with a strong background in pharmaceutical sales who are excited about launching a new product in a very specialized market.

· Manage performance of Pulmonary Hypertension (PH) portfolio, lead the successful launch of a new Pulmonary arterial Hypertension (PAH) product, including market analysis, stakeholder engagement, implementation of launch strategy and monitor territory performance versus targets.

· Build and maintain long-term partnerships with customers (Scientific Leaders, Specialists and specialized Nurses), through individual sales visits, promotional lectures and participation in congresses and educational events.

· Ensure tailored account management for your assigned territory by understanding and mapping your customers, identifying Drivers and Barriers, understanding the patient journey and influencers on treatment decisions per account.

· Engage in balanced product sales discussions including scientific data with Healthcare Professionals (HCPs) to align the customer and business needs.

· Stay up-to date on the latest product and therapeutic area information by attending internal trainings, conferences and symposia, as well as by self-study.

· Drive tailored customer engagements, by using data and analytics to better understand the customer’s preference and by properly balancing physical and digital engagements.

· Organize and co-create educational events for HCP’s including sponsorships in line with strategic priorities and budget constraints.

· Demonstrating highest ethical principles conducting Local law, our company’s Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and regulations.

· 3-5 years of pharmaceutical or biotech sales experience, ideally in specialty care. Experience in Pulmonary Hypertension, Intestinal Lung Disease or Rare Diseases is a strong plus.

· Degree in Life Sciences, medical/paramedical field or another relevant discipline with healthcare curriculum from an accredited institution. shqa Certification «Certified Pharma Sales Representative» is a strong plus.

· Proven experience in managing an existing product portfolio and successfully launching a new product.

· Strong track record of achieving sales targets and supporting marketing efforts in a complex medical environment.

· Excellent communication, relationship-building and presentation skills.

· Ability to manage multiple priorities, with strong organizational and strategic planning skills.

· Experience collaborating with marketing teams to create and implement marketing materials, campaigns and projects.

· Open to innovation and experimentation.

· Fluent in German and additionally English.

· Valid driver’s license.

· Growth-mindset, strong team-player, results-oriented and proven ability to achieve ambitious goals.

· Adaptable to change, ambiguity and a high level of resilience in the face of challenges.

· Independent, motivated and highly organized.

· Excellent interpersonal skills in communication, persuasion and customer relations.

· Possessing a strong learning mindset.

· Identification of challenges or obstacles and proactively ideate on solutions.

· Data-driven decision-making and mindset.

· Comfortable with commercial experimentation and implementing customer projects.

Our Company is a leading biopharmaceutical company employing over 1,000 people in Switzerland at three sites. The company’s headquarters are in Lucerne. At the site in Zurich, the company operates a global innovation and development hub.

In addition, we manufacture medicines for global clinical trials and operate a forensic laboratory in Schachen (Canton Lucerne). We conduct around 40 clinical trials annually in Switzerland. The main therapeutic areas include oncology, infectious diseases, cardiovascular and cardiometabolic diseases.

We also have a broad portfolio of vaccines for the prevention of diseases in children, adolescents, and adults and we are one of the leading companies in veterinary medicine.

Furthermore, we take our responsibility to the local community seriously and have been involved for many years in initiatives such as the «Trendtage Gesundheit Luzern» and the «Alliance Health Competence».
We are proud to be certified as a “Top Employer Switzerland” and “Top Employer Europe” showing the company’s commitment to our employees and the community around us.
One Roof is our new Swiss headquarters in Lucerne designed to bring teams together and make collaboration easier. Across 15,000 m² of modern office space, we unite colleagues from national, regional and global functions within different functions under one roof to strengthen cross functional cooperation and a ONE Team culture. The site is centrally located, a short walk from Lucerne train station, supporting sustainable commuting.

# Un conseiller ou une conseillère en réinsertion pour le bureau AI #
## Temps de travail : 80 % - 100 % ##
L-assurance invalidité (AI) est une assurance sociale obligatoire à l-échelle suisse. Elle soutient les personnes assurées menacées ou touchées par une invalidité par des mesures de réinsertion. L-objectif est que les personnes assurées puissent assurer leur subsistance de manière autonome, totalement ou partiellement. Si une telle réinsertion (ou réintégration) n-est pas ou seulement partiellement possible, l-AI verse une rente (partielle).
Tâches
* Soutien aux personnes avec des limitations de santé pour le maintien de l-emploi ou la recherche d-un poste
* Conduite d-entretiens avec les personnes concernées, les partenaires et les employeurs
* Élaboration d-analyses de situation, de problèmes et de ressources
* Planification de la réinsertion et traitement des décisions d-octroi ou de refus de prestations
* Gestion des dossiers de réinsertion
* Accompagnement des personnes concernées et coordination de tous les intervenants
* Activité sur le terrain dans le canton des Grisons
Exigences
* Personnalité intégrative avec expérience en intégration professionnelle ou assurances sociales
* Formation achevée en coaching/gestion de cas un atout
* Connaissances médicales un atout
* Résistant, sûr de soi en négociation, efficace, orienté client et objectif
* Expression orale et écrite assurée dans les langues cantonales

Founded in 2018, Quince was built to challenge the idea that nice things have to cost a lot. We believe everyone deserves exceptional craftsmanship and timeless design without the traditional markups. Quince is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) model that cuts out middlemen and leverages just-in-time manufacturing to minimize waste and maximize value.
Quince is a tech company disrupting the retail industry by putting AI, analytics and automation at the center of everything we do. Our unwavering commitment to excellence and company values guide our teams and actions:
Customer First : We prioritize customer satisfaction in every decision.

At Quince, you will be part of a high-performing team that is redefining what quality, value, and sustainability mean in modern retail. s.h: We're looking for Business Development Representatives
s.t:
We’re building a new insurance business from the ground up to protect SMEs, and we’re looking for Business Development Representatives to join our team. If you’re a high-energy communicator who loves building relationships and wants to gain experience, qualifications, and career progression at a leading fintech, apply now.
The company
We're here because we believe in SMEs. We believe they deserve better than confusing jargon, slow and outdated customer experiences, and being caught out by hidden conditions and fees. And we believe it's our job to help them navigate risk with confidence.
Since 2012, iwoca has made finance fast, flexible, and fair for over 150,000 businesses. Now, we're doing the same for insurance. We're building a brand new insurance business from the ground up — to protect SMEs in the moments that matter most.
Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed by providing access to better finance and services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team is a small, entrepreneurial group responsible for launching iwoca's new SME insurance business. Here’s how the team work together:
Customer-obsessed: The team challenges itself to build insurance that its customers actually want, rather than what insurers simply want to sell.
Curious & supportive: The team collaborates across disciplines to find creative solutions to complex problems in a safe and supportive environment.
Move fast & have fun: The team is fast-paced and highly autonomous, but makes sure to celebrate wins and have fun along the way.
Ambitious & entrepreneurial: The environment is ideal for people who thrive on taking ownership of their work and are ready to roll up their sleeves and build.

You’ll be the person introducing our new insurance offering to businesses who are tired of the status quo. You’ll help SMEs move away from complicated, slow insurance policies and make them aware of a fairer, more transparent way to protect their business.

Proactively engage with SME business operators by phone ahead of their business insurance renewal date to offer a better alternative.
Master the art of the pitch—navigating gatekeepers, articulating our value proposition, and turning objections into opportunities for our brokers to help them.
Manage your pipeline end-to-end within our HubSpot CRM, ensuring meticulous record-keeping and proactive follow-ups so that no opportunity is missed.
Collaborate closely with our in-house brokers and wider team to turn early customer feedback into insights that refine our product offering and sales strategy.

Previous experience navigating outbound or client-facing interactions within a professional business environment.
Exceptional communication skills, with the ability to build rapport, influence decisions, and handle commercial objections over the phone and email.
A high-energy, resilient, and results-oriented personality that thrives on achieving goals. You have sharp problem-solving instincts and a "can-do" mindset.
Organised and proactive approach to managing your workload.
Ability to adapt and excel in a fast-moving, high-growth atmosphere.
Eagerness to learn - insurance industry experience isn’t necessary - we will provide training to help you succeed.
A desire to secure professional qualifications and drive long-term career progression within a rapidly scaling fintech environment

We expect to pay around £30,000 plus bonus for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.
The culture
At iwoca, we prioritise a culture of learning, growth, and support, and invest in the professional development of our team members. We value thought and skill diversity, and encourage you to explore new areas of interest to help us innovate and improve our products and services.
The offices

About LiveKit
LiveKit is the default infrastructure layer for real-time AI, the platform that gives AI the ability to see, hear, and speak. From powering voice for millions of ChatGPT users to enabling drone teleoperation at Skydio and serving as the backbone for roughly 25% of 911 emergency calls in the U.S., LiveKit handles the real-time media layer that production AI applications depend on.
Over 300,000 developers and 5,000+ companies from leading AI labs to Fortune 500 enterprises run production workloads on LiveKit. We've raised $181M from investors including Index Ventures, Altimeter Capital, and Salesforce Ventures, and we're growing fast. Now we're building the sales team to match.

We're hiring an Enterprise SDR to drive top-of-funnel pipeline for our enterprise sales motion. You'll be the first impression LiveKit makes on engineering leaders, product organizations, and AI/ML teams at companies building the next generation of voice and multimodal AI applications.
This is not a boilerplate SDR role. Our buyers are technical staff engineers, heads of infrastructure, VP-level AI product leaders and they can smell a templated sequence from a mile away. You'll need to understand what LiveKit actually does, why developers reach for it over rolling their own WebRTC stack, and how to translate that into compelling, relevant outreach for each account you work.
You'll partner closely with our enterprise AEs and work directly with sales and marketing leadership tto sharpen messaging and positioning as we scale our GTM functions.

Own outbound pipeline generation targeting Fortune 2000 accounts across key verticals: including healthcare, financial services, and technology companies.

Research target accounts to craft highly personalized, technically credible outreach via email, LinkedIn, and phone
Book discovery calls and product demos for enterprise AEs; provide full context so they walk in sharp and prepared
Work closely with the broader GTM org marketing, solutions engineering, and product on campaign strategy, ICP refinement, and feedback loops that sharpen our enterprise motion
Surface market intelligence back to the product and GTM teams as you're often the first to hear what buyers care about
Hit and exceed monthly and quarterly pipeline targets

1–3 years of SDR or BDR experience, ideally at a developer tools, infrastructure, or voice AI company

Experience using AI tools to accelerate prospecting and personalization at scale

Technical credibility. You'll sell something that engineers respect. That matters if you care about representing products you believe in.

## **Conseiller/ère commercial(e) Région Mittelland, Berne et Soleure** ##
*100 % · Bilingue allemand - français · rattaché(e) au responsable des ventes à Eclépens · entrée immédiate ou à convenir*
**Le poste - en résumé**
Ce poste est un rôle classique de chasseur. Votre première tâche n'est pas de gérer un portefeuille clients existant, mais d'en construire un. Vous identifiez les entreprises industrielles de votre région qui ne collaborent pas encore avec CRIDEC, ouvrez des portes, construisez un pipeline de nouveaux clients - et le maintenez systématiquement actif.
Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions : c'est l'une de nos valeurs - et c'est exactement ce que nous attendons de notre développement commercial. Ne pas attendre que le marché vienne à nous - le conquérir activement.
*Conquérir - le cœur du poste*
* Identifier et acquérir activement les entreprises industrielles de la région Mittelland qui ne sont pas encore clientes.
* Fixer des rendez-vous qualifiés, identifier les besoins en matière d'élimination des déchets spéciaux et développer des solutions adaptées.
* Conclure : calculer les prix, établir les offres - même les plus complexes - et remporter la commande.
*Suivre - avec une discipline inflexible*
* Entretenir activement chaque contact : chez nous, un lead sans suivi est un lead perdu - et nous ne perdons aucun lead.
* Maintenir le CRM en temps réel : chaque visite, chaque action de relance, chaque opportunité est enregistrée.
* Gérer votre activité à l'aide d'indicateurs clés : rendez-vous qualifiés, taux de conclusion, pipeline. Vous les connaissez, les suivez et en assumez la responsabilité.
*Représenter*
* Être le visage de CRIDEC dans le Mittelland : événements sectoriels, partenaires, associations.
* Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l'équipe commerciale et s'appuyer sur nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour.
**Ce qui nous motive**
Chez CRIDEC, la protection est primordiale : c'est le véritable sens de notre travail. Nous préférons agir de manière proactive plutôt que de subir les évolutions, tenir nos promesses même lorsque c'est difficile, et avancer ensemble dans le respect mutuel. Dans ce poste, ces valeurs prennent une signification concrète : chaque promesse faite à un prospect est tenue, chaque action de relance annoncée est réalisée, et chaque client gagné est bien accompagné.
**Ce poste vous correspond si**
* La conquête de nouveaux clients est votre terrain de jeu : vous avez une expérience avérée et démontrable en acquisition B2B - et c'est ce que vous aimez dans ce métier.
* Vous êtes bilingue allemand - français, ou avez l'allemand comme langue maternelle avec d'excellentes connaissances en français (oral et écrit).
* Les objectifs basés sur les chiffres ne vous font pas peur : vous êtes habitué(e) à travailler avec des KPIs, un CRM et des rapports réguliers - et vous y voyez un outil, pas une contrainte.
* La vente industrielle est votre univers : vous connaissez les longs cycles de décision, les multiples interlocuteurs et les défis techniques - et savez comment tenir la distance du premier contact à la signature du contrat.
* Vous connaissez la région Mittelland (Berne, Soleure) et êtes prêt(e) à passer la majeure partie de votre temps sur le terrain.
*Ces cinq points sont indispensables. Sans eux, nous ne pourrons malheureusement pas prendre en compte votre candidature.*
Des connaissances dans le secteur des déchets, la chimie ou le domaine environnemental réglementé sont un avantage clair - nous vous formons cependant dans le domaine technique. Le talent pour l'acquisition et la persévérance ne s'apprennent pas.
**Vos compétences**
* Vous aimez ouvrir des portes - le premier contact vous stimule plutôt que de vous freiner.
* Résilience et endurance : un refus est pour vous une information, pas un échec - et un cycle de vente de dix-huit mois ne vous effraie pas.
* Orientation résultats : vous vous fixez des objectifs ambitieux et faites spontanément rapport de leur avancement.
* Organisation et suivi rigoureux : rien ne se perd, rien ne reste en suspens.
* Excellentes compétences en communication et en gestion des relations, tant avec les techniciens qu'avec les acheteurs. Sensibilité aux questions environnementales : vous vendez une solution utile - et vous y croyez.
**Ce que nous vous offrons**
* Un marché à conquérir : la Suisse alémanique est une priorité stratégique, et vous en êtes la force motrice.
* Un haut degré d'autonomie ainsi qu'une influence directe, visible et mesurable sur les résultats de l'entreprise.
* Une mission porteuse de sens dans un secteur central pour la transition écologique.
* Une entreprise à taille humaine, majoritairement publique, en forte croissance, où vos idées comptent.
* Une voiture de fonction.
* La possibilité de télétravail partiel.
* Le soutien de nos deux sites d'Eclépens et Winterthour ainsi que d'équipes fières de leur travail.
* Un salaire correspondant à votre expérience sur la base de 13 mois, ainsi que des prestations sociales attractives.
**Votre candidature**
Vous aimez conquérir de nouveaux marchés et construire un pipeline qui tient ses promesses ? Vous souhaitez mettre votre talent commercial au service d'une entreprise engagée pour l'environnement ?

Job Description
Turnitin is seeking a disciplined, resourceful, and self-driven Sales Development Representative to drive sales growth by strategically prospecting into new accounts and identifying high-quality leads for the sales team.
As the first point of contact for new business prospects, you will be a crucial partner to our account executives. Your role is to develop a robust pipeline of qualified opportunities by conducting market research, executing data-driven campaigns, and developing dynamic territory plans.

You will understand the Turnitin Integrity and Assessment product portfolios to assess potential customers' needs, mitigate objections, and position the right solutions.

You will own the relationship until the prospect is qualified and ready to engage with a sales account executive, allowing them to focus on closing deals while you focus on generating new opportunities.

Strategic Planning & Prospecting: Conduct market research and analysis to inform go-to-market strategy. Collaborate with your regional sales team to develop and execute a dynamic territory plan, identifying key opportunities and ensuring all activities have measurable outcomes.
Lead Generation: Actively prospect into assigned territories to generate new leads. Develop and execute targeted multi-touch inbound and outbound campaigns via social media, email, and phone to drive engagement and build a robust pipeline.
Lead Qualification & Advancement: Follow up on, qualify, and nurture all assigned leads. Navigate institutional buying processes by mapping key decision-makers and influencers. Skillfully mitigate prospect objections by clarifying concerns and responding with well-prepared solutions.
Collaboration & Communication: Work closely with the sales team to determine the next steps for each prospect. Keep the sales team informed on project statuses, ensuring all relevant CRM systems (like Salesforce.com) are updated in real-time.
Performance & Development: Achieve or exceed all assigned Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Manage detailed prospect account lists, diligently tracking lead progress. Continuously learn and develop your technical, competitive, and sales skills.

3+ years experience as a sales development representative with a track record of achieving lead/sales quotas.

Demonstrated experience initiating and nurturing relationships with potential customers using targeted outbound prospecting techniques (social media, email, phone).

Flawless communication skills (oral and written) and comfort presenting to prospects.

Experience using prospecting applications like LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

About Toptal
Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that enables companies to scale their teams, on-demand. With $200+ million in annual revenue and team members based around the globe , Toptal is the world’s largest fully remote workforce.
We take the best elements of virtual teams and combine them with a support structure that encourages innovation, social interaction, and fun. We see no borders, move at a fast pace, and are never afraid to break the mold.

As an Enterprise Sales Executive at Toptal , you will be a key driver of growth within our Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

In this role, you will identify, develop, and close opportunities with enterprise provider, payer and life sciences clients by helping them solve complex business challenges across a broad range of capabilities, including technology, marketing, management consulting, and AI-enabled transformation.

You will develop tailored solutions that help clients accelerate strategic initiatives and achieve measurable business outcomes.
This role is designed for true hunters who thrive in a high-performance, client-facing environment. It is ideal for individuals who are passionate about building a book of business from the ground up, forging executive relationships, and creating long-term client value. Success in this role is measured by your ability to convert new enterprise relationships into durable revenue and to establish Toptal as a core services provider embedded in your clients’ critical initiatives.
This is a remote position with concentrated field work across the US. We do not offer visa sponsorship or assistance. Applicants must be authorized to work in the US at the time of hire. Resumes and communication must be submitted in English.

Healthcare and Life Sciences organizations are transforming due to regulatory changes, and pressure to perform far outpacing their current abilities. AI has shifted from experimentation to execution, and companies across this sector are actively rebuilding how work gets done, across therapeutic development, care delivery and healthcare financing. Toptal ’s Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) vertical already partners with some of the largest organizations in the world on exactly this work.
This role exists to bring expanded coverage to the US, where our client concentration and opportunity density are highest, and to convert that density into new enterprise relationships. You will report directly to the General Manager of the Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) industry vertical.

The following information is intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties, responsibilities, or required skills.
You will be responsible for building a targeted portfolio of accounts via identifying, prioritizing, and developing your own book of business rather than inheriting an existing one. Once you have signed net new customers, you will partner with Client Partners to deepen and expand those strategic relationships over time.

Net new accounts typically involve mid-level stakeholders across one or two business units and call for a disciplined, transactional approach, matching skills to immediate needs with speed and precision. As relationships mature, accounts become more complex, with deeper engagement across multiple business units and senior executive relationships.

These accounts demand a highly consultative, strategic approach that includes navigating cross-functional priorities, aligning to evolving client business objectives, and demonstrating credibility at the C-suite level.

Success will require the ability to adapt your engagement style to the maturity and complexity of each account, while consistently driving value and long-term growth.
Own and build a portfolio of enterprise Healthcare and Life Sciences (HLS) accounts, with direct accountability for new logo acquisition, revenue growth, and client outcomes.
Prospect, pitch, negotiate, and close new opportunities in close partnership with our Sales Development Representatives (SDRs), while expanding the relationships you establish.
Define and execute account strategy, including opportunity creation, pipeline development, and multi-year growth planning.
Lead solution development and deal execution in partnership with Industry GMs, Practice Leaders, Pursuits, and Delivery teams.
Partner with Client Partners to drive coordinated account expansion and maximize total account value as accounts mature.
Shape industry solutions that apply Toptal ’s technology, marketing, consulting, and AI capabilities to the operating model challenges facing healthcare and life sciences organizations.
Maintain disciplined pipeline and account intelligence to support accurate forecasting and informed decision-making.
Lead strategic conversations with prospective and existing clients, while exercising discretion and independent judgment.
Your portfolio will ramp over your first 9-12 months, after which you will be measured against an annualized gross sales target of $3.5M, aligning with our broader portfolio strategies.

Dive into our sales methods, our selling processes, and playbooks.

Establish credibility with client stakeholders through informed, consultative engagement tied to their priorities and current initiatives.
Own your pipeline and forecast with confidence.

As a leading U.S. ordering and delivery marketplace, we feature over 415,000 merchants in more than 4,000 cities, creating the ultimate food experience by elevating online ordering through innovative restaurant technology, easy-to-use platforms, and an improved delivery experience.

We are constantly finding new ways to innovate—from integrated grocery delivery with groceries powered by Instacart to exclusive loyalty programs. Join our team, based out of New York City, Chicago and Denver, and help us give our diners the exceptional value they deserve.
About The Opportunity
The Grubhub Sales Executive role is a great opportunity to leverage your sales skills to make an impact on the company’s rapid growth. Plus, you’ll be selling restaurant owners exactly what they already want: more business. Our current Sales Executive’s love the team events, contests, and of course the meal perks. This is the place to hone your sales skills, and make great money doing it.
You’ll be on the front lines of building Grubhub’s national restaurant partner network. You’ll research and consult with restaurants, contact and meet with decision makers, and show them how Grubhub can benefit their business. You’ll need to be resourceful, persuasive, determined, competitive, and have the ability to easily connect with people from all walks of life.
The Impact You Will Make
Discover Grubhub’s next wave of great local restaurants: We need you to engage the most wanted restaurants in your territory and help us discover those hidden gems our diners are craving.
Be the market expert: gather restaurant feedback, monitor competitor activity, marketing opportunities, and provide recommendations for improvement to management.
Consult with restaurant owners on the benefits of joining GrubHub and having access to our rapidly growing community of hungry diners. Identify needs and goals of the restaurant and demonstrate how Grubhub can help grow their business.
Conduct extensive cold calling (60+ dials per day), emailing, and social outreach to prospective decision makers.
Manage a territory and own the entire sales pipeline from prospecting to closing.
Secure appointments with prospective clients to uncover needs and present the value of a partnership.
Travel into the market to conduct in person sales pitches with merchant owners.
Exceed high-volume sales goals while working within a team environment.

s.h: What you get to do in this role

These service offerings include our Impact success offering, product implementation services, and training. The Services Account Executive is well-versed in services and post-sales adoption strategies. A quota carrying role, the Services Account Executive owns the Services sales strategy by proactively creating demand for new Services opportunities and partnering with the ServiceNow Sales team and our partners to develop and successfully execute Services sales opportunities for their assigned territory.

The Sales Associate is responsible for providing all Marine Corps Exchange (MCX) customers with world class customer service with an additional emphasis on courtesy.

Sales associates are the primary service providers and will assist customers in every aspect of the retail business in a friendly, professional, and proactive manner that supports continued customer loyalty.

Sales associates assist their customers in challenging scenarios by using an I can do that mindset, to make all attempts for a positive customer experience and outcomes, before asking for support from the next level mentor or supervisor.

Sales associates are brand and customer program ambassadors for all Marine Corps and MCX programs, including but not limited to, Military Star, Super Star Student, customer satisfaction surveys and Keep it New.

This position can be scheduled throughout the facility, based on the needs of the business including but not limited to, cashier or self-checkout attendant, customer service, salesfloor / department support, stockroom / backroom, and military clothing.

In addition to working indoors, associates may be required to work outdoors or inside coolers and/or chillers. Limited time durations and proper Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided when working inside coolers and/or chillers.

Sales associates who are regularly scheduled in areas are expected to learn basic product knowledge to support customer satisfaction and service.

Sales associates perform store operations tasks such as but not limited to, customer and register transactions, Planogram revisions and setups, identifying missing products, replenish sales floor and coolers, setting promotional signage, visual merchandising, maintaining backroom standards through the 5S program and other operational tasks.

Light housekeeping tasks such as but not limited to, sweeping, dusting and trash removal may be part of daily assigned duties. Sales associates are supported by the Specialist role with mentoring, guidance, and training. Sales associates are expected to work with, learn from and request guidance from Specialists in addition to their supervisors.

Sales associates utilize and complete tasks with basic retail equipment including, but not limited to, cash registers, time clocks, RF scanners, mobile printers, handheld equipment (i.e., Price labeling units, box cutters), signage equipment and basic fixture equipment such as, but not limited to peg hooks, shelves, and mobile stocking carts (5S Program).

Assists in preparing and participates in year-end inventory and preparation. Identifies and communicates potential risk of loss and/or theft. May require additional training or certifications as required by the business and/or normal working assignments, including but not limited to, food safety training and fuel.

Articulates MCX value stories and engages with all team members through positive conversations and driving customer satisfaction in a teams win environment. Adheres to safety regulations and standards. Adheres to established standards of the EEO program and prevention of sexual harassment. Performs other duties as assigned.

This is a mixed position where the associate must be able to lift and carry objects up to 45 lbs. independently and objects over 45 lbs. with assistance.
At least 1 year experience working in a customer and sales-focused environment is preferred. Cash handling, basic math and register experience strongly preferred. Ability to read and understand operating standards and procedures for service, service recovery, sales and store brand and work within the position to execute these standards properly.

Ability to work in a high-performance atmosphere with commitment to service and sales goals. Attention to detail is required. Please include MONTH/YEAR and HOURS per week for all previous work experience listed on the resume. If there is no indication of time in position, we will credit the minimum.

The BDR will maintain consistent engagement with prospective partners, coordinate meetings and introductions, track relationship progression, and ensure promising opportunities are appropriately qualified and advanced within the channel partnership process.

Identify and engage key decision-makers, influencers, and relationship owners within national and regional consulting and brokerage firms.
Establish the organization as a trusted and knowledgeable resource within the consultant and broker community.
Develop relationships over time through consistent, thoughtful, and value-added engagement.

Develop and execute targeted outbound campaigns to consultant and broker organizations through email, phone, LinkedIn/social selling, events, networking, and other channels.
Research target firms, their areas of specialization, client portfolios, market priorities, and key stakeholders to create highly personalized outreach strategies.
Generate new conversations and qualified opportunities that align with the organization's growth and channel partnership objectives.

Understand consultant and broker influence within prospective accounts and identify opportunities where channel relationships can accelerate growth.
Coordinate introductions and discovery meetings between consultants/brokers and the appropriate internal sales or channel partnership leaders.
Maintain accurate and timely documentation of relationship activity, opportunities, next steps, and pipeline progression within CRM systems.
Channel Pipeline Development
Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective consultant and broker relationships and opportunities.
Partner closely with the SVP, Channel Partnerships to prioritize target firms, develop account strategies, and determine appropriate engagement approaches.

Collaborate with Channel Partnerships, Sales, Marketing, and other internal stakeholders to ensure coordinated engagement with consultant and broker partners.
Support preparation for consultant/broker meetings, presentations, industry events, and partnership discussions.
Help develop and refine messaging, materials, and engagement strategies designed specifically for the consultant and broker audience.
Support broader channel partnership initiatives and strategic growth priorities as directed by the SVP, Channel Partnerships.

Consistently achieve activity, relationship-development, qualified-opportunity, and pipeline-generation objectives.
Demonstrate disciplined follow-through and accountability in managing a large portfolio of prospective relationships.
Continuously test and refine outreach strategies to improve engagement, conversion, and channel pipeline performance.

Als Consultant für Klinikinformationssysteme gestalten Sie die digitale Transformation in Schweizer Spitälern und Kliniken aktiv mit. Sie schlagen die Brücke zwischen medizinisch-pflegerischen Kernprozessen und moderner IT-Architektur.
In dieser Schnittstellenfunktion begleiten Sie anspruchsvolle Einführungen von Klinikinformationssystemen, Optimierungsprojekte und Change-Prozesse von der ersten Prozessanalyse über das Anforderungsmanagement bis zur erfolgreichen Inbetriebnahme vor Ort.
Unser Mandant ist eine etablierte und hochspezialisierte Schweizer Beratungshaus-Boutique, die sich auf die digitale Transformation im Gesundheitswesen und im öffentlichen Sektor fokussiert hat. Über uns
Du möchtest die Zukunft der Blaulichtorganisationen aktiv mitgestalten? Du verbindest Fachwissen im Sicherheitsumfeld mit strategischem Denken, Beratungskompetenz und Freude an wirksamer Zusammenarbeit? Dann werde Teil unseres Teams und bringe deine Erfahrung und Expertise dort ein, wo sie Wirkung entfaltet.
Die CSP unterstützt ihre Kundinnen dabei, sich organisatorisch, technologisch und kulturell erfolgreich weiterzuentwickeln – von der Strategie bis zur Umsetzung. Dabei betrachten wir jede Organisation ganzheitlich von der Strategie über Prozesse und Technologien bis hin zur Unternehmens\- und Korpskultur.
Interessiert? Dann findest du hier weiterführende Informationen zur CSP und hier zu unserer Arbeitsweise und unserem Bewerbungsprozess.
Was wir bieten
Wir bieten dir als mehrfach ausgezeichneter Great Place to Work® folgendes:
Flexibler Arbeitsort: Dein Arbeitsort richtet sich nach deinen Aufgaben – Je nach Tätigkeit und Bedarf erfolgt dein Einsatz bei Kundinnen, im Büro oder im Home\-Office.
Selbstorganisiertes Arbeiten: Flexibilität und flache Hierarchien geben dir Raum, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, unternehmerisch zu wirken und Ideen einzubringen.
Gemeinschaft: In dynamischen Teams arbeitest du an sinnstiftenden Transformationsprojekten. Die CSP zählt knapp 80 Mitarbeitende mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen – Regelmässige Events und Austauschformate sorgen für inspirierenden Austausch.
Entwicklung: Individuelle Lernwege, Zertifizierungen, Coaching, Mentoring und klare Entwicklungspfade schaffen Raum für Weiterentwicklung, bis hin zur Perspektive auf Partnerschaft.
Viele weitere Vorteile: Arbeiten im Ausland? Engagement in gemeinnützigen Projekten? Kontaktiere uns und wir erzählen dir gerne mehr. Oder überzeuge dich selbst auf Kununu, Linkedin, unserer Homepage oder in unserem Kultur Booklet.
Dein Impact
Beratung und Begleitung von Organisationen im BORS\-Umfeld (Polizei, Feuerwehr, Rettungsdienste, Zivilschutz, Führungsstäbe, Behörden) bei strategischen, organisatorischen und operativen Fragestellungen.
Leitung und Steuerung von Projekten und Transformationsvorhaben im BORS\-Umfeld, insbesondere in organisationsübergreifenden Konstellationen mit hohen Anforderungen an Koordination, Verlässlichkeit und Wirkung.
Analyse und Weiterentwicklung von Zusammenarbeits\- und Einsatzstrukturen (z. B. Führungsorganisationen, Ausbildungs\- und Einsatzorganisationen, Schnittstellen zwischen BORS\-Partnern) zur Verbesserung der Leistungsfähigkeit im Alltag sowie in besonderen und ausserordentlichen Lagen.
Konzeption und Umsetzung von Digitalisierungs\- und Innovationsvorhaben im BORS\-Kontext, etwa in den Bereichen Einsatzunterstützung, Lagebild, Kommunikation oder Prozessautomatisierung.
Aktive Mitgestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unseres Leistungsangebots im Bereich Sicherheit / BORS, insbesondere durch die Vertiefung und Weiterentwicklung relevanter Themen wie Resilienz, Krisenmanagement, Stabstraining und organisationsübergreifende Zusammenarbeit.
Aufbau, Pflege und gezielter Ausbau deines Netzwerks im BORS\-Umfeld sowie Mitwirkung bei der Akquise und Positionierung der CSP als kompetente Partnerin im Sicherheitsbereich.
Dein Skill Set
Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ca. 5 Jahre oder mehr) in Beratung und/oder Projektleitung – idealerweise im Public Sector, BORS\-Umfeld oder in staatsnahen Organisationen (siehe unsere Kernbranchen).
Fundiertes Verständnis für das BORS\-Umfeld und dessen spezifische Herausforderungen, Abläufe und Anspruchsgruppen sowie ein starkes Netzwerk mit der Fähigkeit, dieses gezielt für Marktaufbau, Akquise und die Positionierung der CSP im Sicherheits\- und BORS\-Umfeld einzusetzen.
Ein akademischer Abschluss auf Stufe Universität oder Fachhochschule ist von Vorteil, aber keine Voraussetzung. Entscheidend sind Fachwissen, Erfahrung und nachgewiesene Wirkung in der Praxis.
